findings.summary: Multiple directories with 20+ files indicate potential hub modules creating coupling issues
evidence: Flat directories with many files detected by desloppify structural analysis
findings.suggestion: Consider splitting large directories into subpackages with clear responsibilities

findings.summary: Mixed naming conventions across the codebase
evidence: Inconsistent naming patterns observed in file structure
findings.suggestion: Standardize on snake_case for all Python files

findings.summary: Mixed error handling strategies across codebase
evidence: Multiple catch blocks that only log errors without re-raising
Some functions return None on error, others raise exceptions
findings.suggestion: Standardize error handling with custom exceptions and consistent propagation

findings.summary: Facade modules with re-exports but no concrete implementations being used
findings.suggestion: Remove unused re-exports or ensure they're properly imported elsewhere

findings.summary: sys.path mutations at import time detected in multiple files
evidence: sys.path.append() calls at module level in 4 files
findings.suggestion: Use proper relative imports or install package in development mode

evidence: Multiple files with 0 tests and high LOC
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for critical production modules, especially high-blast-radius files

findings.summary: Demo and prototype files may not be production-ready
evidence: Files with if __main__ but zero importers
findings.suggestion: Move demo/prototype code to scripts/ directory or add proper tests

findings.summary: Orphaned files with entry points but no importers
evidence: Files have if __name__ == '__main__' but no imports
findings.suggestion: Move standalone scripts to scripts/ folder or add proper module imports

findings.summary: Complex nested directory structure with mixed purposes
findings.suggestion: Flatten or reorganize package structure to reduce nesting
Use dependency injection or class-based configuration instead of globals

findings.summary: Large monster functions detected that could be refactored
findings.suggestion: Break down large functions into smaller, focused units

findings.summary: Mixed design patterns across similar modules
evidence: Different approaches to similar problems across modules
findings.suggestion: Document and enforce consistent design patterns across codebase
